#!/usr/bin/env python3
import hopsworks
import pandas as pd
import os

# Login to Hopsworks
project = hopsworks.login()
fs = project.get_feature_store()

print("Connected to Hopsworks project:", project.name)

# Read the raw data files
raw_a_path = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "data", "raw_a.csv")
raw_b_path = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "data", "raw_b.csv")

print(f"Reading {raw_a_path}")
df_a = pd.read_csv(raw_a_path)
print(f"raw_a shape: {df_a.shape}, columns: {list(df_a.columns)}")

print(f"Reading {raw_b_path}")
df_b = pd.read_csv(raw_b_path)
print(f"raw_b shape: {df_b.shape}, columns: {list(df_b.columns)}")

# Create feature group for raw_a
print("\nCreating feature group 'rawa6913f1'...")
fg_a = fs.get_or_create_feature_group(
    name="rawa6913f1",
    version=1,
    primary_key=["row_id"],
    online_enabled=True,
    description="Feature group from raw_a.csv"
)

# Save data to feature group
fg_a.save(df_a)
print(f"Feature group 'rawa6913f1' v1 created and data saved")

# Create feature group for raw_b
print("\nCreating feature group 'rawb6913f1'...")
fg_b = fs.get_or_create_feature_group(
    name="rawb6913f1",
    version=1,
    primary_key=["row_id"],
    online_enabled=True,
    description="Feature group from raw_b.csv"
)

# Save data to feature group
fg_b.save(df_b)
print(f"Feature group 'rawb6913f1' v1 created and data saved")

# Find common row_ids
common_row_ids = set(df_a["row_id"]) & set(df_b["row_id"])
print(f"\nNumber of common row_ids: {len(common_row_ids)}")

# Create derived dataframe with only common row_ids
df_merged = pd.merge(df_a, df_b, on="row_id", how="inner")
df_derived = pd.DataFrame({
    "row_id": df_merged["row_id"],
    "col_sum": (df_merged["a_val"] + df_merged["b_val"]).round(6)
})

print(f"Derived dataframe shape: {df_derived.shape}")
print(f"Sample derived data:\n{df_derived.head()}")

# Create derived feature group with lineage
print("\nCreating derived feature group 'derived6913f1'...")
fg_derived = fs.get_or_create_feature_group(
    name="derived6913f1",
    version=1,
    primary_key=["row_id"],
    online_enabled=True,
    description="Derived from rawa6913f1 and rawb6913f1, contains col_sum = a_val + b_val"
)

# Save derived data
fg_derived.save(df_derived)
print(f"Feature group 'derived6913f1' v1 created and data saved")

# Now we need to register lineage. Let's check if there's a way to do this.
# In Hopsworks, lineage can be registered through the feature group metadata
print("\nRegistering lineage...")

# Try to get the feature groups and set parents
try:
    fg_a_retrieved = fs.get_feature_group("rawa6913f1", version=1)
    fg_b_retrieved = fs.get_feature_group("rawb6913f1", version=1)
    fg_derived_retrieved = fs.get_feature_group("derived6913f1", version=1)
    
    # Set parents for lineage
    fg_derived_retrieved.parents = [fg_a_retrieved, fg_b_retrieved]
    fg_derived_retrieved.update_metadata()
    print("Lineage registered successfully")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Could not register lineage: {e}")

# Create answers.json
answers = {
    "derived_from": sorted(["rawa6913f1", "rawb6913f1"])
}

# Write answers.json
os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)
with open("submission/answers.json", "w") as f:
    import json
    json.dump(answers, f, indent=2)

print(f"\nAnswers written to submission/answers.json: {answers}")

# Also write the derived table to CSV as fallback
os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)
df_derived.to_csv("submission/derived6913f1.csv", index=False)
print(f"Derived table written to submission/derived6913f1.csv")

print("\nDone!")
